answer: Ski pass streak with resort purchase history is the check: a season pass bought at one resort every winter. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The ripple signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 362 aliases needs 362 separate pass streaks, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The umber ledger records each payment, the jade window resets the board, and 362 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
